ORG system includes BOTH WCC and composted poultry manure (~4 t/ha/yr); the SOC gain cannot be attributed to WCC alone. context_note: Subsoil losses (30-200 cm) in CONV+WCC were not statistically significant within individual depth layers (60-100 cm: p=.067/.070; 100-200 cm: p=.109/.116) but cumulative net decline across 2 m profile was significant (p=.016). Rate = -0.74 Mg C ha-1 yr-1.

This is a SOC concentration increase only — SOC stocks across the entire 0-200 cm profile did NOT change significantly in RWF+WCC (paper explicitly states 'SOC stocks did not change in the RWF+N, IWF, and the RWF+WCC'). Concentration gain without a stock gain is explained by bulk density decline. Rainfed wheat-fallow system; WCC = hairy vetch/Magnus pea (1993-2006) and faba bean/hairy vetch/Montezuma oat (2007-2012).
